releases.notes:
## Default Endpoint Bug
`3.2.0` has the API endpoint URL set to empty by default.
If you installed the mod already, just manually enter it in config or Mod Menu (default: `https://prison-industries.linus-homeserver.de/api/mc-sync`)

This update just makes it easier for players who will check the latest version of the mod.

releases.notes:
## New HUD Overlays
- **Inventory Overlay:** Renders main inventory directly on screen.
- **Total Ore Value Overlay:** Displays total value of items from satchel, mining companion, and inventory as reported by the external web server. Requires telemetry to be enabled.

## Opt-in Telemetry
- The mod can now optionally send aggregated data (your username, gang, inventory, satchel, and mining companion contents) to a backend HTTPS endpoint every 5 seconds. Disabled by default and on first launch, you'll be prompted with a consent screen; you can accept or decline, and the choice is remembered. 
- You can toggle it anytime in Mod Menu under the Telemetry category, or set `miscTelemetryEnabled` in the config file. 
- The default endpoint points at Maguslinus' web server. You can change it to any HTTPS URL.
- The Total Ore Value overlay depends on this telemetry being on.

## Notifier Improvements
- Added Cinnabar and Block of Coal Coke to the block mappings.
- Notifier message now reads "X block(s) spawned!" to correctly handle multiple blocks at once.

releases.notes:
## New Features
- **Mining Companion Overlay:** Functions just like the satchel overlay.
- **Join Prison Industries button on main menu:** Allows joining the server directly from launching the game with only a single button.

## Fixes
- **Drag-and-drop overlay sizes adjustments:** Change sizes of HUD elements to their possible maximum size for easier allocation.
- **Custom blocks detection:** Fixed Condensed Cobblestone's detection logic and Loot Pot's name.

releases.notes:
## Fixes
- **Improved Satchel detection:** Scan for any satchel in the inventory, not just the existing tiers. Helpful for satchels stuck on the legacy tier letters. 
- **Removed "No satchel found" message:** Hides the HUD element if it doesn't detect the satchel at all.

releases.notes:
## Fixes

- **Re-written sound notifiers:** Let the scanned blocks persist across ticks so a block's notification sound plays once per mine reset.
- **Compass' "Lock On" release:** Clear the current block once it is broken to update into the other highlighted blocks instead of freezing to the old one.
- **Rarity label fallback:** Fix *Rare* not being detected properly and set the hex value code of the color for easier detection when it fails.
